images.caption: A Bristol Biplane replica (also called the Boxkite) hangs from the ceiling of the main hall of Bristol City Museum, Bristol, England. This aircraft was made in 1963 for the film “Those Magnificent Men in their Flying Machines“. The Bristol connection is that all 76 Boxkites were manufactured at Filton, on the outskirts of Bristol.

images.caption:
Bronze sculpture of Kathleen Garman by Jacob Epstein, titled "Kathleen" and made in 1935, while she was his mistress (they later married).
Now at Bristol City Museum and Art Gallery. 

The position of her hands and arms are closely modelled on those of Andrea del Verrocchio's marble bust 'Lady with Primroses'.

images.caption:
Bristol Parkway railway station, GloucestershireOpened in 1972 by British Rail where its lines from Birmingham to Bristol and London to South Wales cross.
View west towards Bristol and South Wales from the east-bound platform. When opened there were only 2 platform faces, a modest car park and a small booking hall. By 2021 the car park was double decked (far right), a larger booking hall had been opened (centre right), there were 4 platform faces and the railway line had been electrified.
images.alt:

View west towards Bristol and South Wales from the east-bound platform. When opened there were only 2 platform faces, a modest car park and a small booking hall.
